title: Would you run this campaign for Spotify? 🎯
description: Would you run this campaign for Spotify? 🎯
transcript: This is what I do if I was running paid ads for Spotify Premium. So the current ads are just boring and they're very much selling features more than they are feelings. So I build the campaign around one core idea, and that's that premium removes the moments that ruin your music. So show someone on the tube with no signal, someone mid workout getting interrupted by an ad, someone on a flight who forgot to download music, someone hosting a party and suddenly an ad plays. And playing into these pain points makes the message much stronger. Things like still getting interrupted? Try premium free for one month. To be clear, this is risky because by doing this they're criticizing their own free version. So I wouldn't recommend this for a challenger brand. But Spotify can do it cause they're not a challenger. They're the 800 pound gorilla in the music streaming world. They can afford to take a risk like this.
